types.name: BloodborneDLAdaptiveMutex
types.c_declaration: typedef struct BloodborneDLAdaptiveMutex { uint64_t vtable; int32_t spin_ticks; uint32_t unknown_0c; uint64_t semaphore; uint64_t owner_waiters; } BloodborneDLAdaptiveMutex;
evidence: 原始机器码和RELA布局校验；实例地址不写入符号。字段布局不是并发替换等价性证明。

fields.name: vtable
evidence: 构造0x2037b86；队列最终替换为0x53a1990，Lock/Unlock仍继承同一入口。

fields.name: spin_ticks
evidence: Lock+0x2037d03使用movslq；队列+0x203281f写200000。

fields.name: unknown_0c
evidence: 布局占位，语义未知，不据此做写入。

fields.name: semaphore
evidence: Lock+0x2037d68读取，WaitSema(1,null)；Unlock+0x2037e96读取后SignalSema(1)。

fields.name: owner_waiters
evidence: 锁定CAS；低40位线程owner，高24位waiter；Unlock有waiter时以低40位全1哨兵交接。

types.name: BloodborneCharacterMemberTask
types.c_declaration: typedef struct BloodborneCharacterMemberTask { uint64_t vtable; uint64_t group; uint32_t retirement_mode; uint32_t unknown_14; uint64_t object; uint64_t member_pointer; int64_t this_adjustment; } BloodborneCharacterMemberTask;
evidence: 48字节分配和成员函数表示来自原始ELF；计时只观察执行，没有修改任务内容。

fields.name: vtable
evidence: 成员任务构造+0x1a656e0和execute+0x1a66390；task执行槽+0x10。

fields.name: group
evidence: 构造保存组指针，executor在回调后减少group+0x30。

fields.name: retirement_mode
evidence: executor+0x20337be读取低32位，控制删除/引用释放路径。

fields.name: unknown_14
evidence: 占位，未推断语义。

fields.name: object
evidence: execute加载this。

fields.name: member_pointer
evidence: 0x109表示虚表偏移0x108；低位0为直接成员目标。

fields.name: this_adjustment
evidence: execute在调度前加到this，当前构造写0。
